title: Chairperson, NAITSA Senate
description:
Chairperson, NAITSA Senate
Contract-basis
The NAIT Students’ Association (NAITSA) is seeking an experienced, impartial Chair to preside over meetings of the NAITSA Senate, our elected student governing body.
This opportunity is suited to someone with keen knowledge of parliamentary procedure, experience chairing formal meetings, and an approachable manner that connects well with student leaders.
Position Summary
The Chair facilitates orderly and efficient Senate meetings by applying NAITSA’s governing documents and Robert’s Rules of Order Newly Revised.
For many Senators and Executive Council members, this is their first experience with formal governance meetings. The Chair draws on their experience to offer patient guidance and set clear expectations, helping Senate members understand meeting procedures, build confidence, and participate effectively.
The Chair remains impartial, supports respectful discussion, and ensures members have a fair opportunity to participate. They also help members understand the distinction between governance and operations, and support the Senate in carrying out its oversight responsibilities, while respecting the Senate’s authority to deliberate and make decisions.
The Chair works closely with the Senate Secretary on meeting preparation and procedural matters, and with the Executive Director on Senate training. NAITSA uses an online board platform for meeting management and Zoom to host online Senate meetings.
Responsibilities

• Prepare for and chair online Senate meetings in accordance with NAITSA’s official Bylaws, governing documents, and Robert’s Rules of Order Newly Revised.

• Become familiar with NAITSA’s bylaws and other governing documents.

• Facilitate fair, respectful, and focused discussions, encouraging participation while maintaining impartiality.

• Guide members through motions, debate, and voting, explaining procedures clearly and patiently.

• Work with the Executive Director to deliver a Senate training session on parliamentary procedure, governance responsibilities, and meeting expectations.

• Collaborate with the Senate Secretary on meeting preparation and provide procedural guidance to Senators and Executive Council members as needed.

• Maintain confidentiality, disclose potential conflicts of interest, and attend all scheduled meetings and training sessions for the contract term.

• Remain available to consult with NAITSA Executive Council and Senators, and provide additional training throughout the year, as needed.

• The Chair receives an annual invitation to attend NAITSA’s Awards Night, where Senators are recognized for their contribution on the board.

Required Qualifications and Experience

• Demonstrated experience chairing formal board, council, committee, or comparable governance meetings.

• Strong working knowledge of Robert’s Rules of Order Newly Revised and the ability to apply parliamentary procedure in real time.

• A sound understanding of board governance and the respective roles of a governing body and elected representatives.

• Strong facilitation skills, including the ability to manage competing perspectives and difficult discussions fairly.

• Clear communications skills and the ability to explain unfamiliar procedures without jargon.

• An approachable, patient, and respectful manner, with the ability to build rapport with students from varied backgrounds and levels of experience.

• Availability for scheduled meetings, training, preparation, and agreed consultation.

• Reliable internet access and a private workstation/computer with a camera and microphone suitable for chairing online meetings.

Assets

• Registered Parliamentarian certification or another relevant parliamentary credential.

• Experience working with student associations, post-secondary institutions, nonprofit boards, or elected bodies.

• Experience training, mentoring, or leading individuals and teams.

• Familiarity with online board platforms and virtual meeting facilitation.

title: Transcriptionists (Independent Contractor) - Textile
description:
What you will do:
As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.
We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.
This project is specific to the textile industry and we are seeking individuals with this experience or background.
Who we’re looking for:

• Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files within 24 hours or less for an hour-long file.

• People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

• Transcriptionists who are fluently bilingual or multilingual are always welcome.

Requirements

• Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our in-house style manual as well as project-specific instructions.

• Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

• A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.

• For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.

• Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.

• ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?
No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

• Current resume (PDF)

• Cover letter (PDF)

• A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

About the Team

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.

The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. Collaborate across teams. You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.

Travel expected approximately 25% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the heart of a significant platform transformation. You will be a core contributor to a squad that is actively changing how it builds, owns, and delivers software, and you will have real influence over the quality and direction of that work.
We are moving from a traditional release cycle to CI/CD, shifting shared services into team-owned boundaries, and embedding AI into how the team thinks and delivers. You will be working alongside a Tech Lead to drive those changes forward, bringing technical craft and an AI-native approach to everything you build.

Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

• Supplies and other perks

title: Technical Account Manager Architect - EMEA
description:
ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 4,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.

As a TAM Architect, you're the named technical lead for a small group of our largest customers. You carry the context of how they run ClickHouse, guide them from their first design decisions through production and growth, and make sure the rest of ClickHouse shows up for them when it matters. Your job is to keep them healthy, help them get more out of ClickHouse, and spot the next use case.

You'll work inside our Support organisation and, at this stage, take ad hoc cases alongside support engineers as well as escalations for your own accounts, so you see how a much wider range of customers use the product. The role is based in Israel, close to some of our biggest customers in EMEA.

Large enterprises are moving onto ClickHouse fast, and we're building out how we look after them. People joining now have a real say in how this role works.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run a regular cadence with 4 to 8 strategic accounts (weekly, fortnightly or monthly, depending on the project), plus quarterly health checks and business reviews, on site where it helps

- Lead onboarding, where the decisions that are hardest to reverse get made: schema and data modelling, table engines, ingestion, migration and query design

- Once customers are live, keep performance and cost on track as they grow, and help them onto new use cases

- Work closely with Support: take ad hoc cases alongside support engineers, and own escalations for your accounts, with regular case reviews and a direct line into L3 engine

- Work with the right people for each piece of work: Partner with Solutions Architects on new use cases and proof of concepts, and bring in Consulting Engineers for hands on projects in

- Write it down: documented setup and configuration, knowledge base articles and reference architectures that help other customers too

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing technical role after the sale, whether your title was TAM, solutions architect, professional services, senior support or something else

- Specialist depth in data modeling, query performance and integration on distributed or analytical databases

- Hands-on SQL. You regularly write complex queries from scratch, and tune and debug them yourself

- Experience owning a small book of high-touch enterprise accounts, where you know each customer's architecture in depth

- Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP and/or Azure) and a working knowledge of Kubernetes

- You explain technical trade-offs clearly, to engineers and to executives

- Fluent English and Hebrew

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with ClickHouse, or with other analytical databases such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Druid

- Involvement in open source, as a user, contributor or community member

GOOD TO KNOW

- You'll be based in Israel. Travel to customer sites is part of the job, up to 35% of your time, within Israel and throughout EMEA

- You'll join our EMEA Support Services team, where Support Engineers, Consulting Engineers and TAM Architects work as one team

- You'll be part of the on-call rota, about one week a quarter, with time off in lieu if you're paged at a weekend

HOW WE HIRE

- A 30-minute call with our recruiter

- A conversation with the hiring manager

- A take-home exercise, designed to take four to five hours, with three working days to complete it

- A 90-minute technical interview with the team: you'll walk us through your take-home, then join a working session where you write and tune SQL live

- A final conversation with our VP of Support Services

- References, then an offer

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

SENIOR SCIENTIST & PROGRAM LEAD | ENZYMOLOGY

WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

Velocity Bio is a venture-backed startup spun out of Stanford University combining cutting-edge microfluidics with AI to accelerate discovery of next-generation therapeutics. We are building the world’s largest dataset of high-fidelity enzyme function to train AI models for allosteric drug discovery and accurate enzyme function prediction.

Recently, Velocity partnered https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7514071489558749185 with the Institute for Protein Design at the University of Washington, Argonne National Laboratory, and SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory on a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project to harness AI for breakthrough enzyme design. With our partners, we’re building the missing, massive quantitative datasets of activity and structure for computationally-designed enzymes needed to unlock next-generation AI models to design enzymes de novo with unprecedented fidelity.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you’ll work closely with the founding team on our mission to unlock AI models for allosteric drug discovery and accurate enzyme function prediction. To do this, you’ll scale large-scale, high-fidelity enzyme function datasets, develop novel in vitro enzyme assays on our proprietary microfluidic platform, and manage external collaborations. This role will combine hands-on wet-bench biochemistry, data generation and analysis on Velocity’s high-throughput platform, as well as leadership by managing internal and external projects. As an early hire, you’ll have significant opportunity to work with the founding team and shape the scientific direction and culture of Velocity.

THIS ROLE WILL INVOLVE

- Designing, performing, and analyzing high-throughput enzyme assays on Velocity’s platform

- Designing and managing large-scale internal/external data generation campaigns

- Developing new high-throughput classical quantitative biochemical assays

- Working closely with AI/ML engineers to guide model development and evaluations

- Shaping Velocity’s scientific roadmap alongside the founding team

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- PhD in life sciences (Biochemistry, Biophysics, Chemical Biology, or Structural Biology preferred)

- 3+ years of relevant industry experience

- Expertise in enzymology and in vitro functional assays

- Deep understanding of protein structure and function

- Fluent in common molecular biology techniques (construct design, cloning, DNA and protein purification, etc.)

- Fluent in Python programming

- Ability to move quickly between strategic planning and hands-on execution

- Exceptional scientific rigor and attention to detail

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience leading large-scale internal/external projects

- Hands-on experience performing other protein biophysical assays characterizing stability, binding, etc.

- Experience performing recombinant protein expression and purification

- Experience with NGS workflows

THIS POSITION MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU…

- Are passionate about working on problems with huge potential to improve human health

- Enjoy rigorous science and designing and performing complex biophysical experiments

- Are excited to shape an early startup and influence how we work and what we build

- Are highly organized and a self-directed learner

- Want to join a fast-paced, collaborative environment in the heart of the Bay Area

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary and equity

- Full health, dental, and vision insurance

description:
Your Impact at LILA

Our team works on AI methods for therapeutic protein design, with a tight loop between computation and the wet lab. A co-op could take on either of two tracks, or a mix of both. (1) Generative models and protein design pipelines: build, benchmark, and improve methods for designing proteins (such as antibodies and minibinders), with candidates tested in our lab so results are grounded in experimental data. (2) AI agents for protein design campaigns: build and evaluate agents that help plan campaign strategy (target and epitope selection, choosing methods and settings), execute campaigns (launching design and filtering runs, diagnosing failures, adapting the next round), and reason over biological priors from the literature alongside the outputs of domain-specific models. Either way, the co-op would own a well-scoped project, ship code and analyses that feed real design decisions and scientific outcomes.

What You'll Be Building

• Develop, evaluate, and apply agentic systems for protein design and/or deep generative models for protein design.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Strong python and and computational science background.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Experience with machine learning for molecular design

Bonus Points For

• Experience with customizing agents, building harnesses, or using agents for scientific applications

• Solid technical understand and experience with generative models.

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. description:

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As Workplace Specialist, you are Harvey's Workplace team in Toronto. You run the office end to end: the space, the service partners behind it, the experience employees and clients have in it, and the front door. You are the person everyone in the office turns to, and the one who actually knows.

Your manager sits in another office and time zone. You take priorities and standards from them and from the global Workplace team, then run the office with real independence. You escalate the calls that need a manager: contract terms, spend above your authority, and anything with cost, risk, or precedent attached.

Du musst nicht vom ersten Tag an alles wissen. Mit Deinen fundierten Grundlagen und Deiner Motivation, unterstützen wir Dich, Dich in Themen wie die Telematikinfrastruktur und API/Konnektoren, einzuarbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben 

Du bist technische Ansprechperson rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur - von der Schnittstellen-Architektur über Kartenverwaltung bis hin zu Gematik-Standards. Kein Tag ist wie der andere.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

- API-Integration und Troubleshooting sind für dich kein Neuland - du hast echte Erfahrung damit, Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen.

- Du kennst dich mit komplexen IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerken und sicherheitskritischen Systemen aus - und weißt, worauf es in solchen Umgebungen ankommt.

- Du kannst technische Sachverhalte so erklären, dass sie ankommen - egal ob du gerade mit einer Entwicklerin oder einer Praxismanagerin sprichst.

- Deutsch fließend (C1) und Englisch solide (B2) - du bewegst dich in beiden Sprachen sicher.

Das ist ein Plus - oder du lernst es bei uns:

- Kenntnisse rund um die Telematikinfrastruktur, Gematik-Standards oder andere Healthcare-IT-Systeme - wer schon mal mit KIM+, eAU- oder E-Rezept-Workflows gearbeitet hat, ist klar im Vorteil.

title: Technical Account Manager

OUR MISSION

We’re not your average benefits platform - we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive-both at work and beyond.

YOUR MISSION

As a Technical Account Manager at Ben, you'll own the technical relationship with a book of enterprise customers and be their voice in everything we build.

Your customers are HR and benefits leaders running benefits for thousands to tens of thousands of people across multiple companies. They depend on Ben for managing their benefits, wallets and allowances and payroll reporting, and they depend on you to know their setup inside out. You'll understand their accounts well enough to see trouble coming and to get to the root cause when something breaks.

You’ll also be the voice of the customer here. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering, bringing them what your customers need and why it matters, and helping decide what we build next.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING...

- Own the technical relationship: be the go-to technical contact for your enterprise customers, helping them with all platform-related issues

- Get to the root cause: dig into API errors, SSO and authentication issues, integrations and payroll data to work out what's happening, then resolve it or give Engineering a case they can reproduce

- Guide customers through change: lead admins through new setups, integrations and configuration changes, and run training sessions for their teams

- Stay ahead of your accounts: know your customers' key moments, from enrolment windows to renewals and payroll runs, and proactively raise risks and get ahead of things before they land

- Be the voice of the customer: take the patterns you see across your accounts to Product and Engineering, back them with the tickets and conversations behind them, and follow them through to what gets built

YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE…

- Customer-facing experience (essential): you've worked directly with customers in a TAM, Implementation, Technical Support, Operations or Technical CSM roles, ideally within B2B SaaS start-up/scale-up environments

- Owned enterprise accounts: you've managed enterprise customer relationships yourself, juggled several accounts at once, and know when to handle something and when to escalate it

- Hands-on technical troubleshooting: you've debugged API integrations, worked through SSO and authentication issues, and read logs to find the cause of a problem yourself

- Worked closely with Product and Engineering: you've taken a customer problem to an engineering team, made the case for it, and seen it through

- AI in your day-to-day work: you already use AI tools to do your job faster or better, and you can show us something you've built or changed with them. Experience with Devin or Claude specifically isn't needed

NICE-TO-HAVES, BUT NOT DEAL-BREAKERS:

- Experience with benefits platforms, HR tech, payroll systems, or employee benefits administration (nice to have)

- SQL experience and experience working with/testing/troubleshooting APIs (nice to have)

WHY JOIN US?

You'll own the relationships with a book of well-known enterprise customers and help them run the benefits their people rely on, from health cover to allowances. Benefits are hugely important to the employees of customers we serve, so getting them right matters to thousands of people at every company you look after, and you'll have the responsibility to make sure things run smoothly.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - INDIA

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

- Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

- Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

- Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

- Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

- Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

- Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

- Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

- You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

- You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

- Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

- Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

description:
About Imagine Worldwide

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.
Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.
Role Overview
The Data Quality Analyst focuses on data quality across Imagine’s data ecosystem. The role proactively monitors data from devices, programme systems and field sources, builds and improves the checks that catch problems early, and investigates issues raised across the organisation. Where an issue requires deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work, the role provides its findings and works with the relevant team member to resolve it.
Imagine’s data covers learning activity from tablets in more than 1,500 schools, along with programme, operational and field data. Devices sync intermittently and sources don’t always agree, so checking data against what is happening in schools and in the field is central to the work.
The role reports to the Director of Analytics and works closely with the Data Scientist, who provides methodological support. It suits an analyst who enjoys tracing a problem back to its source and wants to keep developing in a small team. As they build context on Imagine’s data, the role takes on more ownership of the team’s data quality reporting and standards.
Key Responsibilities
The Data Analyst’s responsibilities fall into four pillars: data quality monitoring and improvement, data issue investigation, communicating findings, and analytical practice.
Data Quality Monitoring and Improvement
The role takes a proactive approach to data quality, identifying risks and gaps before they affect reporting or decision-making.

• Monitor the completeness, consistency and plausibility of data across Imagine’s sources, and identify issues independently.

• Design and implement data quality checks, and recommend where further checks or controls are needed across pipelines and source systems.

• Develop tooling and automated monitoring that make data quality issues visible, working with the Analytics Engineer on implementation within the platform.

• Reconcile figures across related sources and investigate discrepancies.

• Contribute to the team’s data quality reporting, rules and standards.

Data Issue Investigation
The role is the Analytics Team’s first point of investigation when data issues are identified, whether through monitoring or raised by colleagues.

• Investigate data issues and trace them to their root cause across source systems, pipelines and data models.

• Work with the Analytics Engineer, MEAL and country teams to resolve issues at source and confirm their resolution.

• Handle assigned data quality and data export requests from the Analytics Team’s request process.

• Document findings and hand over issues that require deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work to the relevant team member.

• Support the team’s data quality incident process by providing the evidence needed for decisions.

Communicating Findings

• Write concise summaries of data issues and investigations, covering the cause, the impact and the recommended action.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Recruiting Coordinator in NYC to help us deliver an exceptional candidate experience and help build the operational foundation that allows our team to hire quickly without compromising on quality.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is exceptionally organized, proactive, and excited to build a career in people & recruiting while helping scale a fast-growing startup.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own interview scheduling and coordination across multiple teams/searches, including complex onsite and virtual interview loops.

- Partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers to keep hiring processes moving quickly and efficiently.

- Support the broader employee experience through onboarding, recruiting events, and other projects as needed

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Exceptional verbal and written communication. Clear, warm, and concise, and stays calm under time pressure.

- Strong sense of urgency and the ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality

- Comfortable working with senior leaders and managing frequently changing schedules and priorities

- Attention to detail. Time zones, room bookings, interviewer swaps, you catch it before anyone else does.

- Ownership + self-direction. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't wait to be told what's next - you thrive in fast-moving environments where processes are still being built

title: FCM - Corporate Travel Consultant (SFO Team) - USA
description:

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. To learn more about FCM please click HERE
About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel

• Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals

• Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs

• Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process

• Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations

• Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares

• Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans

• Other duties and tasks as assigned

• Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

• 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.

• In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.

• Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.

• Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.

• Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.

• A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.

• Proficiency in handling multiple urgent task

title: Senior Manager, Training
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

THE ROLE

Docker is building a Training practice to accelerate customer onboarding and adoption, and help them realize measurable value from Docker’s AI Governance products. As Senior Manager, Training you will own learning journey design, operations and outcomes.

This is a founding role. You will start as an individual contributor, personally building the first learning paths and standing up the platform, and you will grow into leading a team as the Training function scales.

This is a high-visibility role within our Professional Services organization and works directly with leadership in Professional Services, Technical Account Management and Onboarding Specialists. You’ll define how new customers learn to implement Docker in their first weeks and months, developing user and administrator self-led journeys and instructor-led workshops. You’ll prove Training impact with data tied to onboarding, implementation and adoption milestones, and the value customers realize.

You will build on a modern learning stack anchored on Skilljar and Instruqt. You will make AI a core part of how customers are implemented, using agents to produce content, coach learners, and run learning operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the training journey for customer implementation training, focused on admins, IT, security, DevOps teams and non-developer teams adopting Docker Sandboxes and AI governance products.

- Own the learning technology stack built on Skilljar and Instruqt, including catalog and learning-path structure and authoring workflows

- Build hands-on: author the first implementation paths, labs, and assessments, and configure and administer Skilljar and Instruqt.

- Design the training practice to be AI-native using built in features from Skiljar and Instruqt and support from Professional Services engineers: agents draft courses, lab guides, and assessments from product docs, release notes, and engineering changes, and flag stale content, with an SME review gate for technical accuracy before anything is published.

- Establish repeatable curriculum standards: implementation path templates, hands-on lab patterns, assessment and badging criteria, content review and refresh cycles and web-based customer journeys.

- Partner with technical subject-matter experts within Professional Services to build content, and support them on authoring in Instruqt.

- Use AI agents, vendors, contractors, and SMEs as leverage to scale output ahead of headcount.

- Define team model: roles, sequencing, and the business case for first hires.

- Ensure learner data practices meet Docker’s privacy, security, and vendor review standards, including PII minimization and DPA requirements for training platforms and any AI models that process learner data.

_______________________________________________________________________

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED

- 10+ years in technical training, customer education, or enablement leadership at a SaaS/infrastructure company, including 5+ years leading programs or teams, with a record of building a function from the ground up.

- Comfortable as a hands-on builder and sole practitioner, with the ability to hire and lead a team as the function grows.

title: Account Executive, Trucking Insurance

We are seeking an Account Executive to support a growing commercial auto and transportation book of business. This opportunity is well suited for an insurance professional who has developed a strong foundation in commercial auto, ideally within trucking, and is ready to take the next step in their career with increased responsibility for renewals and account management.

The Account Executive will partner closely with brokers to support new and renewal business, prepare market submissions, evaluate account information, coordinate with internal teams, and help deliver responsive service to clients and trading partners.

• Support commercial auto and transportation business, applying knowledge of the segment to understand account exposures and assist with renewal strategy.

• Prepare market submissions, quote cover letters, proposals, and other documentation for new and renewal opportunities.

• Review applications, quotes, coverage documents, and account information for completeness and accuracy.

• Develop an understanding of individual accounts and proactively identify information needed to move submissions and renewals forward.

• Partner with brokers on new business strategies and assist with proposals and presentations for prospective clients.

• Build strong working relationships with brokers, underwriters, clients, and internal partners while developing a broader understanding of brokerage operations.

• Evaluate account information and potential risks while ensuring work complies with applicable regulations, internal policies, and established guidelines.

• Maintain accurate account and client information within internal systems and ensure documentation meets established quality and service standards.

• Leverage account and portfolio information to help brokers identify trends and opportunities within the book of business.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure contractual and service obligations are met.

• Partner with Premium Accounting and other stakeholders to help resolve invoicing issues and communicate regarding notices of cancellation.

Qualifications

- Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling - audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing - to help customers reach successful outcomes.

- Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

- Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

- You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

title: Certification Architect
description:
About the Team

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

Within Customer Education, the Certification team helps individuals demonstrate competence for in-demand AI skills and helps customers and partners validate that their workforce has the skills they need to meet their AI-enabled business goals. Our work centers on the belief that learners should understand where to go to build skills and capabilities, how to demonstrate them, and what to pursue next. Similarly, Enterprise leaders should understand what each credential signifies and how it supports workforce readiness. We do this with transparency for the overall OpenAI credential framework and providing trusted, role-based certifications that verify practical capability.

About the Role

As Certification Architect, you will define the framework, standards, and assessment architecture that make OpenAI certifications a trusted signal of demonstrated capability.

This is a senior hands-on role on the Certification team that will build reusable foundations for a growing portfolio: clear competency standards, defensible assessments, scalable in-product delivery, and evidence of continued competence.

We’re looking for someone who combines deep certification and assessment expertise with the ability to innovate new and meaningful ways to demonstrate practical AI competence. You will work closely with certification specialists, technical subject matter experts, learning product and engineering teams, operations and policy partners, and stakeholders across the go-to-market organization.

The program is early, and you will help shape how people demonstrate capability in ChatGPT and Codex. Success means building standards that are rigorous, usable, and adaptable as AI technology and professional roles evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Own the credential framework and shared competency standards, distinguishing completed learning, demonstrated skills, and formal certification, with clear capability claims and evidence requirements for each.

- Establish reusable assessment standards and guidance for certification pods across job-task analysis, competency models, assessment blueprints, performance tasks, scoring rubrics, and passing standards.

- Own the validation approach and evidence documentation requirements. Partner with pod leaders to validate certification proposals against job relevance, representative task coverage, scoring consistency, fairness, and appropriate interpretation of results.

- Define exam delivery architecture and requirements with product, engineering, operations, and third parties, spanning registration, identity verification, monitoring, permitted assistance, evidence capture, scoring, human review, appeals, customer support, and record management.

- Define expectations for continued competence validation post-assessment.

- Partner with learning, operations, policy, legal, privacy, security, and accessibility teams to align preparation with competencies while protecting assessment integrity and establishing appropriate evidence access, retention, accommodations, and review processes.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 10+ years experience designing and delivering professional technical IT industry certifications or assessments that support credible claims about what people can do.

- Have led design of performance-based assessments for AI, software development, technical architecture, or customer-facing implementation roles.

- Have built credential frameworks, competency models, or shared assessment standards that work across multiple roles
